title: E2.3 pipe-select gesture (Mode.SELECT) has zero test coverage
evidence:
signal pipe_selected(pipe_id: int)
const CLICK_SLOP_PX := 6.0 # press-release movement still counted as a click
enum Mode { NONE, DRAW, ORBIT, SELECT }
	_picked_pipe = flow_view.pick_pipe(screen_pos, camera)
	_mode = Mode.SELECT if _picked_pipe >= 0 else Mode.ORBIT
	if was == Mode.SELECT and _picked_pipe >= 0 \
			and screen_pos.distance_to(_press_pos) <= CLICK_SLOP_PX:
		pipe_selected.emit(_picked_pipe)
	if was != Mode.NONE and was != Mode.SELECT:
		gesture_ended.emit(screen_pos)
--- grep -rn 'pick_pipe\|pipe_selected\|Mode.SELECT\|SELECT' tests/ -> 0 matches. test_input.gd (unchanged, E1) pins classify() DRAW/ORBIT only; test_gesture.gd (updated for E2) still drives only the DRAW commit/cancel paths.
detail: New input-grammar branch (SELECT) plus two behavior changes to _end — SELECT suppresses gesture_ended and emits pipe_selected only within click slop; dragged select silently becomes orbit. None is pinned headless.
recommended_fix: Extend test_gesture.gd: build a pipe, press on its arc, assert router._mode==SELECT; release within 6px asserts pipe_selected fires and gesture_ended does not; drag beyond slop asserts orbit took over.

title: FlowView.pick_pipe geometric picking and occlusion guard untested
detail: pick_pipe decides which pipe the click selects — the sole entry to the QoS panel. Its occlusion guard and clampf(0.25,1.5) threshold are load-bearing geometry with no regression pin; a far-side-pipe regression would ship silently.
recommended_fix: Add a headless test: stage the scene, connect two pipes (one front, one antipodal), unproject known arc points through the real camera, assert pick_pipe returns the front pipe id and -1 for empty sky/crosshair positions.

title: QosPanel ladder/fallback/apply logic exercised as noise but never asserted
detail: The panel's only real logic — rung fallback when a class's lane goes inactive (including the Standard-also-inactive edge) and the apply-guard — has zero assertions. Its output feeds set_lanes commands; a fallback bug corrupts player QoS input silently.
recommended_fix: Add a panel unit test: open on a fresh sim pipe, _on_rung(1) then _on_rung(2)/_on_rung(3), assert _alloc/_cls_lane fallbacks and shares label; call _on_apply with _pipe_id=-1 asserting apply_requested stays unemitted.

title: Command-bus invalid-command no-ops mostly untested (add_pipe entirely)
detail: apply_command is the only mutation API and promises deterministic no-ops on invalid input; add_pipe validation and most set_lanes branches (size, range, unknown pipe) have no negative tests — the classic happy-path-only blind spot.
recommended_fix: Extend test_sim_qos._set_lanes_command-style cases: add_pipe with a==b/out-of-range/missing keys asserts pipes.size() unchanged and command_log still records each attempt; set_lanes with alloc.size()!=3, lane 3, [-10,110,0], unknown pipe.

title: Advisory test gate: CONCERNS
evidence:
"**Test contracts:** replay byte-identity on a fixed seed (determinism contract); contention drops by drop precedence (lowest first); a dedicated lane reservation holds its class's capacity; SLA breach is detectable and attributable; view-layer changes never shift sim state." (spec-epic-e2.md)
